players.product: Formulated epoxy resins for AI semiconductors: liquid molding compound (LMC) and advanced sheet molding compound (a-SMC) encapsulants (Nagase ChemteX)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half (April-September 2025) consolidated results: net sales JPY 479,734 million vs JPY 480,976 million (-0.3%); gross profit JPY 90,913 million (+3.3%); operating income JPY 21,058 million vs JPY 21,054 million (0.0%); net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 15,089 million (-5.6%). Management states sales fell partly because the yen strengthened, while the gross margin improved on better profitability at some manufacturing subsidiaries; operating income was flat as M&A-related costs and higher retirement benefit costs raised general and administrative expenses.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 479,734 million (-0.3%); operating income JPY 21,058 million (0.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Electronics & Energy segment, first half (April-September 2025): sales JPY 84,663 million vs JPY 79,938 million (+5.9%); gross profit JPY 21,808 million (+12.8%); operating income JPY 6,767 million vs JPY 5,981 million (+13.1%). Management: sales of semiconductor materials increased; Nagase ChemteX modified epoxy resin sales increased, with products for semiconductors for AI servers solid while those for mobile devices were weak; operating income rose despite M&A-related costs. Segment R&D expenses were JPY 1,041 million of a group total of JPY 2,919 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronics & Energy H1 sales JPY 84,663 million (+5.9%); operating income JPY 6,767 million (+13.1%)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronics & Energy segment scope changes in the first half: SACHEM Japan Holding, SACHEM Japan and a Wuxi, China high-purity chemicals company were consolidated after the company acquired their equity, SACHEM Korea Ltd. was consolidated after a share acquisition, and SN Tech changed from an equity-method affiliate to a consolidated subsidiary after an additional share acquisition.
